items.title: Hario V60 Filters
items.desc:
Filter paper plays an essential role in the brewing of a cup of coffee. This paperis oxygen bleached (and therefore chemical-free), is compatible with the HARIO V60 02 size dripper.
The paper allows you to extract all the goodness and aroma from your freshly ground coffee beans. These filter papers are also biodegradable, meaning that they are good for the environment.
Before brewing your coffee, make sure to rinse with boiling water to get rid of any unwanted flavours contained in the paper.

items.title: Espresso - Footprints
items.desc:
Let us introduce our espresso blend - Footprints. The name is borrowed from one of our absolute favourite jazz compositions with the same name, first released on Wayne Shorters album Adam's Apple in 1966.
We love the name since it reflects our love for music as well as our firm belief that every part of the production chain has an impact on the final cup.
Every part is important, everyone leaves a mark, everybody leaves a footprint.
This has been a work in progress for many years and the time has now come to say farewell to Red Clay and Silent Shout. Although we have enjoyed working with two b

items.title: Timbuyacu
items.desc:
Bourbon de Colasay, variedad de café arábica local única que se cultiva en el distrito de Colasay. Aunque los productores locales se refieren a ella como Bourbon debido a su apariencia similar, las pruebas genéticas sugieren que es una mutación o un cruce local que se asemeja genéticamente al Catimor, pero sin los sabores vegetales o astringentes comúnmente asociados a esa familia.
En este lote en concreto dentro de la finca Timbuyacu, encontramos notas a nueces y avellana principalmente, junto con notas afrutadas que nos recuerdan a la pera y a la ciruela. Además, es un café con tacto muy dul

items.title: Kent
items.desc: Este Kent de Acacia Hills es nuestro café de la casa de Tanzania. Las notas principales son kumquat, almendra garrapiñada y pasas, a las que se suman miel cruda, piel de cítricos y cacao en polvo. Su cuerpo es redondo, como el de un dátil, y su acidez es media, comparable a la de un chocolate del 70 %.

items.title: Kent
items.desc: Este Kent de Acacia Hills es nuestro café de la casa de Tanzania. Las notas principales son kumquat, almendra garrapiñada y pasas, a las que se suman miel cruda, piel de cítricos y cacao en polvo. Su cuerpo es redondo, como el de un dátil, y su acidez es media, comparable a la de un chocolate del 70 %.

items.title: OMBLIGÓN - LAS FLORES
items.desc: Este es uno de los lotes más singulares y experimentales que hemos tenido en NOMAD. Sus notas más distintivas nos recuerdan a cola de cereza, ruibarbo y caramelo de sandía, acompañadas de toques de ciruela negra, mosto de uva y caramelo de grosella. Tiene una acidez brillante y elevada, y un cuerpo sedoso que envuelve el paladar. Un café intenso y complejo, fruto de la variedad Ombligón y de un proceso de fermentación cuidadosamente controlado.

items.title: Esperanza
items.desc: En fragancia es muy dulce, con unas notas a pera y caqui. Además, podemos encontrar notas de panela, pasas y avellanas. El aroma sigue siendo dulce y aparecen notas de chocolate al 70% y de banana. En boca es denso, con un cuerpo almibarado y una acidez media y suave, como la de alguna fruta blanca. Un café equilibrado que funciona muy bien solo y aún mejor con leche.

items.title: Pacas
items.desc: Nos encanta este lote de Pacas de Carlos Pola por su perfil de cereza, canela y chocolate negro. A medida que se desarrolla en la taza, también aparecen nueces de California, manzana roja y azúcar morena. Su cuerpo es redondo y su acidez, media, nos recuerda a bayas y a chocolate.

items.title: Pacamara
items.desc: Nos encanta este Pacamara por su perfil dulce y afrutado. Destacan la mermelada de mandarina, la avellana y el azúcar moscovada, acompañadas de notas de chocolate con leche, ciruela amarilla y panela. Tiene un cuerpo cremoso, con una acidez suave que nos recuerda a la naranja confitada.

items.title: Primavera - La Papa
items.desc: Nuestro café de la casa de Huehuetenango, o “ciudad de los árboles” en lengua maya, ha llegado para quedarse con La Papa. Panela, mantequilla y pasas son sus notas principales, acompañadas de naranja, cacao nibs y avellana. Tiene un cuerpo cremoso y una acidez baja, muy bien integrada, que nos recuerda a la fruta pasificada.

items.title: Camiseta Serveis de Café - Blanca
items.desc:
Serveis de Cafè es el nombre que damos a los momentos en que NOMAD sale de sus espacios habituales para llevar su manera de entender el café a otros contextos.
Confeccionada en algodón de 180 g/m² y fabricada en Portugal, esta camiseta forma parte del universo más cotidiano de NOMAD. La prenda que visten nuestros baristas cuando NOMAD sale de casa. Ahora también disponible para todo el mundo.

items.title: Acaia Balanza Lunar
items.desc:
La Acaia Lunar está pensada específicamente para espresso: su plato compacto encaja bajo cualquier portafiltro y su algoritmo mide peso y flujo de extracción en tiempo real, para dosificar y extraer con precisión de concurso. Su perfil ultrafino y acabado en negro la hacen prácticamente invisible bajo la máquina.
Diseñada para espresso con plato compacto de 10,5 × 10,5 cm apto para portafiltros, mide peso y ratio de extracción en tiempo real. Su perfil ultrafino de solo 15,5 mm de altura incluye conexión Bluetooth 4.0 y batería recargable por USB.
El control total del espresso: desde la dosis

items.title: Mi Finquita Lote M - Natural
items.desc: Este Geisha Natural de Mi Finquita se despliega con una intensa expresión frutal: frambuesas y frutos del bosque en un primer instante, acompañados por la dulzura tropical del mango maduro. En aroma, delicados matices de frambuesas liofilizadas se entrelazan con notas de té rooibos y té blanco. Su textura es sedosa y envolvente, mientras que una acidez fresca evoca la frambuesa y el dulzor de las fresas maduras y el mango aporta equilibrio y profundidad. Es expresivo y persistente, con un final de frutos del bosque que refleja el carácter vibrante y la complejidad de un Geisha Natural.

items.title: Mi Finquita Lote T - Lavado - Fermentado en vidrio
items.desc: Este Geisha Lavado de Mi Finquita se despliega con una brillante expresión floral: delicadas notas de flores blancas y osmanthus en un primer instante, acompañadas por matices de papaya madura y sutiles recuerdos herbales. Su textura es sedosa y limpia, mientras que una acidez fresca que evoca la granadilla se equilibra con el dulzor de la fresa madura. Es preciso y elegante, con un postgusto prolongado donde las notas florales reaparecen, dejando un delicado recuerdo a flor de saúco.

items.title: Mi Finquita Lote B - Lavado
items.desc: Este Geisha se despliega con una brillante intensidad cítrica: yuzu y pomelo rosado en un primer instante, acompañados por delicadas notas de miel de flores, nectarina y albaricoque. En boca, la acidez evoca la mandarina madura, mientras que el dulzor de melocotón y dátiles aporta profundidad y equilibrio. Su cuerpo sedoso recuerda la carnosidad de la guanábana, dando paso a un postgusto prolongado donde los cítricos reaparecen.

items.title: Taza y plato Serveis de café V1
items.desc: Taza de café fabricada en porcelana blanca. Con una capacidad de 180 ml y formato compacto, presenta una silueta funcional y apilable, pensada para optimizar el almacenamiento y el servicio diario.

items.title: Taza y plato Serveis de café V2
items.desc: Taza de café fabricada en porcelana blanca. Con una capacidad de 180 ml y formato compacto, presenta una silueta funcional y apilable, pensada para optimizar el almacenamiento y el servicio diario.

items.title: Taza Serveis de café V2
items.desc: Taza de café fabricada en porcelana blanca. Con una capacidad de 180 ml y formato compacto, presenta una silueta funcional y apilable, pensada para optimizar el almacenamiento y el servicio diario. Su construcción incorpora un borde reforzado que mejora la resistencia frente a golpes y arañazos.

items.title: Test roast
items.desc: Las notas que podréis encontrar irán variando dependiendo del paquete. Así pues podréis obtener tanto un perfil Achocolatado como uno floral, afrutado, dulce.. Desde una taza muy balanceada, a un café muy meloso y aterciopelado.

items.title: Mariana
items.desc: Un café natural goloso, dulce y con mucha profundidad. En la taza encontramos mora confitada, chocolate 70% y almendra garrapiñada como notas principales, acompañadas de mosto de uva, melaza y grosella negra. Su cuerpo es cremoso y deja un final a cacao en polvo. La acidez es media, con un carácter que recuerda a la fruta pasificada y que redondea una taza muy dulce.

items.title: Ají Fellows Farms
items.desc: Nos encanta este Ají por su perfil floral, dulce y afrutado. En la taza destacan la flor de azahar, el pomelo y la fresa confitada, acompañados de notas a miel cruda, piña confitada y chocolate con leche. Tiene un cuerpo almibarado que nos recuerda al melocotón en almíbar y una acidez media, como la de la piña, que mantiene la taza fresca y equilibrada.

items.title: Kii AB
items.desc: Nos encantan los cafés de Kenia por esa fruta intensa y esa acidez brillante. Este café de la estación de lavado Kii es un buen ejemplo de lo que nos gusta en los cafés kenianos. Podrás encontrar en taza notas a higo deshidratado, bergamota y una nota herbal que nos recuerda al té negro. Es un café con un cuerpo meloso, envolvente, muy dulce, con una acidez suave que nos recuerda a la acidez de la fruta deshidratada. También te puede recordar su aroma y sabor a ciruela, miel cruda y papaya. El retrogusto es largo y muy agradable.

items.title: Las Brisas
items.desc: Este café destaca por sus notas de chocolate con leche, nuez de California, y azúcar moreno, que ofrecen una experiencia cálida y reconfortante. A medida que se enfría, emergen sabores de galleta María, dátiles y un toque de almendra y pasas, añadiendo una profundidad interesante.

items.title: Julio Chávez
items.desc: Nos encanta este Geisha por su lado floral y delicado. En nariz destaca el jazmín, acompañado de una nota herbal que recuerda al té blanco y un toque de nectarina. En boca se vuelve más dulce, con matices de panela, miel y naranja que aportan redondez sin restarle finura. El cuerpo es ligero y elegante, con una acidez brillante y jugosa que cierra la taza con mucha frescura.

items.title: Albino Ibias
items.desc: En taza destacan la piña, el melocotón y la pera en almíbar, con matices de níspero, albaricoque y caramelo que se despliegan a medida que la taza se enfría. El cuerpo es almibarado y denso, con una acidez redonda y jugosa que envuelve el paladar. Un lote de trazabilidad de productor único, seleccionado para nuestra gama de Competición.

items.title: Alipio Palomino
items.desc: Nos encanta este lote de Alipio Palomino por su perfil floral, dulce y afrutado, tan propio de la Geisha Inca del valle de Incahuasi. En fragancia destaca la flor de naranjo, acompañada de notas a pasa sultana y chocolate blanco. En boca aparecen matices de fruta madura, chocolate con leche y orejones, sobre un cuerpo almibarado y una acidez melosa que redondean la taza.

items.title: Acacia Hills Pacamara
items.desc: Un café goloso y reconfortante, con notas a chocolate con leche, dátil y piel de cítricos que se despliegan desde la fragancia. En boca aparecen matices de mantequilla, pera y melaza, sumando dulzura y complejidad. Cuerpo meloso y acidez media, equilibrada.

items.title: Centroamericano Natural Anaeróbico
items.desc: Tranquilamente un café top 10 de nuestro menú año tras año. Un tipo de perfil que nos encanta en Nomad. Complejo y salvaje, con notas cremosas y afrutadas. Frutos del bosque, cerezas y cacao nibs en fragancia, dando paso a uvas y tamarindo al entrar en contacto con el agua. Cuerpo aterciopelado, acidez vinosa, y un retrogusto muy elegante de cacao en polvo.

items.title: Karimikui
items.desc: Uno de los cafés con más cuerpo e intensidad que hemos tenido en el menú de NOMAD. Su fragancia nos recuerda a la fruta de hueso, a la miel y a la panela. En cuerpo es intenso, con una acidez brillante y un cuerpo aterciopelado. Este lote de café con proceso lavado de Kenia nos ha trasladado años atrás en el tiempo, a la mejor época de este país en términos de calidad.

items.title: Bombe Natural
items.desc: En los cafés de proceso natural de Etiopía es muy característico encontrar notas a arándanos, chocolate con leche y dátil. Y este lote tiene todo eso y un poquito más. Hemos encontrado notas a fruta confitada, granada y lúpulo acompañadas de un cuerpo cremoso y una acidez jugosa haciendo de este lote, que tenemos cada año, un café muy agradable y complejo.

items.title: Shakiso Hadeso
items.desc: Un café con una fragancia muy dulce y con notas florales que nos recuerdan al lemongrass y a la flor del almendro. También encontramos notas herbales como té blanco. En boca es muy dulce, con una acidez suave y un cuerpo meloso. Cacao en polvo, melón verde y physalis son otras notas que hemos encontrado en este clásico café de Etiopía de proceso lavado.

items.title: Jarra Translucida Fellow
items.desc:
La Jarra Translúcida de Fellow es el complemento perfecto para tu ritual de café de filtro: soplada a mano en vidrio borosilicato, combina ligereza y resistencia con marca de ratio integrada que te ayuda a mantener la proporción de café y agua en cada vertido. Su tamaño compacto es igual de cómodo en casa que detrás de la barra.
Fabricada en vidrio borosilicato soplado a mano, es ligera, resistente y transparente. Cuenta con marca de ratio a 300 ml para dosificar el vertido con precisión, compatible con drippers habituales como Stagg [X]/[XF], Hario V60, Kalita Wave y Origami. Es apta para mic

items.title: Barista Hustle Distribuidor The Comb
items.desc:
The Comb de Barista Hustle es la herramienta de referencia para aplicar la técnica WDT antes de cada extracción de espresso. Sus 30 agujas de punta redondeada rompen grumos del café molido y lo distribuyen de forma homogénea en el portafiltro, evitando canalizaciones y consiguiendo extracciones más limpias y consistentes.
Cuenta con 30 agujas de 0,35 mm que deshacen grumos sin apelmazar el café, con configuración ajustable en línea para rastrillar o en hexágono para distribuir en profundidad. Reduce canalizaciones y mejora la uniformidad de la extracción, con diseño compacto y ligero fácil de

items.title: Motta Picamarro Acero Inoxidable
items.desc:
El picamarro Motta es un básico de cualquier barra de café: fabricado en acero inoxidable robusto, permite vaciar la pastilla usada del portafiltro de un solo golpe, limpio y sin salpicaduras. Su barra de golpeo con revestimiento de goma protege tanto el portafiltro como la propia barra, alargando su vida útil.
Está hecho en acero inoxidable resistente para uso diario e intensivo, con barra de golpeo revestida en goma que amortigua el impacto. Su diámetro de 105 mm es compatible con la mayoría de portafiltros domésticos y es fácil de vaciar y limpiar tras cada uso.
Orden y limpieza en cada ext

items.title: Acaia Balanza Pearl
items.desc:
La Acaia Pearl es la báscula de precisión de referencia para el café de filtro: pesa hasta 2 kg con resolución de 0,1 g y se estabiliza en menos de un segundo, para vertidos exactos y repetibles. Su conexión Bluetooth permite sincronizarla con la app Acaia y registrar ratios, tiempos y curvas de extracción.
Ofrece precisión de 0,1 g con estabilización instantánea, capacidad de hasta 2 kg apta para jarras y sistemas de goteo grandes, batería recargable por USB y conexión Bluetooth 4.0. Su diseño plano y minimalista es fácil de limpiar e integrar en cualquier barra.
Controlar el ratio café-agua

items.title: MHW-3BOMBER Juego de Tubos Energy
items.desc:
El Juego de Tubos Energy de MHW-3BOMBER lleva el single dosing a otro nivel: cada tubo conserva tu café recién tostado en dosis individual, lista para verter directamente en el molinillo sin ensuciar ni desperdiciar. Su válvula unidireccional deja escapar el CO2 del tueste mientras bloquea aire y humedad, manteniendo el aroma intacto.
Ofrece dosis exactas de 20 a 26 g listas para moler sin básculas ni cucharas, con válvula de desgasificación que protege el aroma del café. El set de 8 tubos con soporte de nogal es ideal para varias tazas o cata, con construcción resistente en policarbonato tan

items.title: Shakiso Hadeso
items.desc: Un café natural de la región de Guji que nos recuerda en fragancia a rosas liofilizadas, arándanos confitados y frambuesa. En boca es muy dulce, donde podemos encontrar notas a azúcar blanco, chocolate con leche e higos. Tiene un cuerpo sedoso junto a una acidez jugosa que nos recuerda a los frutos del bosque. Su retrogusto es largo, agradable y muy dulce.

items.title: Camiseta Serveis de Café - Negra
items.desc:
Serveis de Cafè es el nombre que damos a los momentos en que NOMAD sale de sus espacios habituales para llevar su manera de entender el café a otros contextos.
Confeccionada en algodón de 180 g/m² y fabricada en Portugal, esta camiseta forma parte del universo más cotidiano de NOMAD. La prenda que visten nuestros baristas cuando NOMAD sale de casa. Ahora también disponible para todo el mundo.

items.title: Camiseta ICE - Manga corta
items.desc: La Camiseta ICE - Manga Corta es una edición especial diseñada por Nomad Coffee en colaboración con el ilustrador Joan Manel, conocido por su estilo gráfico con guiños a la estética publicitaria de los años 60 y 70. La ilustración, protagonizada por un personaje de hielo en color azul, nos hace un guiño con humor al verano y al café con hielo.

items.title: Geisha Timbuyaku
items.desc: Un café muy floral, típico de la variedad Geisha. Podemos encontrar notas a té blanco y flor de saúco junto a notas afrutadas que nos puede recordar a la nectarine y a la ciruela. Un Geisha lavado riquísimo y disfrutón que nos encanta en NOMAD. Tiene una acidez suave y un cuerpo aterciopelado con un retrogusto largo y muy agradable.

items.title: Cuchara de cata x Nomad
items.desc: Nuestra cuchara de cata NOMAD está diseñada para quienes viven el café a través de cada matiz. Hecha en acero inoxidable de alta calidad, ofrece el peso, la profundidad y la curvatura ideales para sesiones de cupping, tanto profesionales como domésticas.

items.title: Churupallana
items.desc: En fragancia y aroma es un café muy dulce con notas que nos recuerdan a frutos secos y cacao. En boca siguen presentes estas notas, pudiendo ser más específicas, podríamos encontrar notas a nueces y dátiles. Además, hay ligeras notas afrutadas que nos recuerdan a pera y a ciruela amarilla. Tiene un cuerpo denso, una acidez suave y un retrogusto muy agradable.

items.title: Churupallana
items.desc: En fragancia y aroma es un café muy dulce con notas que nos recuerdan a frutos secos y cacao. En boca siguen presentes estas notas, pudiendo ser más específicas, podríamos encontrar notas a nueces y dátiles. Además, hay ligeras notas afrutadas que nos recuerdan a pera y a ciruela amarilla. Tiene un cuerpo denso, una acidez suave y un retrogusto muy agradable.

items.title: Rhino Barista Milk Pro Pitcher
items.desc: Jarra de acero inoxidable para lattear. La jarra de leche Pro de Rhino Coffee Gear ha sido desarrollada por personas que entienden las necesidades del mundo del café de especialidad. Cuenta con medidas grabadas en las paredes interiores de la jarra para garantizar que se desperdicie menos leche y que solo se vierta la que se necesita.

items.title: Nemba
items.desc: En fragancia es muy dulce, con notas a fruta deshidratada como los orejones. Estas notas son muy características de los cafés de lavado de Burundi que tanto nos gustan. También podemos encontrar miel y notas florales a flores blancas. Tiene una acidez melosa y un cuerpo sedoso. El retrogusto es largo y agradable y te deja una sensación en boca melosa y dulce como a miel.

items.title: Cuchillo Pa de Kilo & Nomad
items.desc: Esta colaboración une a Nomad Coffee, Pa de Kilo y Pallarès Solsona en torno a una misma manera de entender el oficio con cuidado y precisión. Fabricado en Solsona siguiendo los procesos tradicionales de Pallarès, este cuchillo está diseñado específicamente para el corte de pan de hogaza. La inscripción "bona feina" toma como referencia los cuchillos tradicionales de Aragón, conocidos como sabateta: piezas de pequeño formato que se llevaban en la faja o el bolsillo para el uso diario, y que en algunos casos también se regalaban como símbolo de compromiso.

items.title: Taza Serveis de café V1
items.desc: Taza de café fabricada en porcelana blanca. Con una capacidad de 180 ml y formato compacto, presenta una silueta funcional y apilable, pensada para optimizar el almacenamiento y el servicio diario. Su construcción incorpora un borde reforzado que mejora la resistencia frente a golpes y arañazos.

items.title: Taza + Plato Service Projects & NOMAD.
items.desc: La Taza SP es el resultado de una colaboración entre Nomad Coffee y Service Projects, diseñada especialmente para las cafeterías de Nomad en Barcelona. Con un estilo minimalista y funcional, esta taza está hecha para realzar cada sorbo de tu café, desde un espresso intenso hasta un café de filtro suave.

items.title: Filtros de Papel AeroPress - 350 unidades.
items.desc: Filtros de papel microfiltrados para AeroPress, diseñados para extraer un café limpio, sin sedimentos ni aceites. El tamaño y la porosidad están optimizados para ofrecer una taza suave, equilibrada y con cuerpo.

items.title: Cafetera Aeropress
items.desc: La AeroPress es una cafetera manual revolucionaria que permite preparar café limpio, aromático y con cuerpo en menos de 2 minutos. Ideal para casa, oficina o llevar de viaje.

items.title: NOMAD COASTER
items.desc: Diseñado por Júlia Esqué, este objeto está cuidadosamente ensamblado en Barcelona a partir de tubos de acero inoxidable. Pensado para sostener bebidas calientes como el café de filtro, permite la circulación del aire y la disipación térmica. Incorpóralo a tu ritual al disfrutar de nuestros cafés.

items.title: Jarra Cyclone Wave Coffee Server
items.desc: El Cyclone Wave Coffee Server va más allá de una simple jarra: es una experiencia sensorial para tu café. Su diseño inspirado en decantadores de vino incorpora el Aroma Peak, que realza los aromas mientras fluyes el café, y el motivo Aeration Wave para una oxigenación óptima del líquido.

items.title: Gahahe
items.desc: Este café destaca por su perfil vibrante con notas florales, mandarina y piña asada. En boca, ofrece un equilibrio perfecto entre dulzura y acidez jugosa, complementado por matices sutiles que lo hacen ideal para filtro. Su carácter afrutado y fresco lo convierte en una opción excepcional para disfrutar en cualquier ocasión.

items.title: BÁSICO BARISTA
items.desc:
Escala tu habilidad: Curso para cafeterías intermedio
En el mundo del café, cada detalle cuenta. Desde la selección del grano hasta la presentación de una taza perfecta, la maestría de un barista profesional es sinónimo de dedicación y conocimiento. Durante nuestro curso intermedio, te invitamos a sumergirte en un viaje formativo donde las técnicas de café avanzan mano a mano.
Nuestros cursos para cafetería intermedio son ideales para mejorar tus conocimientos y habilidades detrás de la barra. Creado para profesionales del sector que quieren impulsar sus conocimientos. Perfecciona la preparaci

items.title: GEISHA - NATURAL
items.desc: Este Geisha se despliega con una brillante intensidad floral: lavanda y rosas en un primer instante, seguidas por la dulzura jugosa de los arándanos maduros. Su textura es sedosa y limpia, mientras que una acidez equilibrada sostiene los sabores con claridad y persistencia. Es preciso y expresivo, un testimonio del potencial del proceso natural cuando se realiza con cuidado.

items.title: Fellow Aiden Filters
items.desc: Filtros de fondo plano diseñados específicamente para la Fellow Aiden Precision Coffee Maker. Pasaron por muchas iteraciones para traer este diseño.

items.title: EUGENIOIDES - NATURAL
items.desc: Esta especie poco común revela una dulzura delicada que recuerda al azúcar glas, suavizada por notas de papaya y melón. Su dulzor es extraordinariamente alto, equilibrado con una acidez muy baja y sin rastro de amargor. El cuerpo es sedoso y aterciopelado, probablemente de las texturas más suaves que se pueden encontrar en un café. Con su contenido naturalmente bajo en cafeína, la taza resulta singular: un raro encuentro de dulzura, seda y fruta.

items.title: GEISHA - LAVADO
items.desc: Este Geisha lavado es un ejercicio de claridad. Aromas de jazmín y rosa dan paso a una taza refinada y luminosa, con una acidez brillante e integrada que enmarca notas de cítricos, kiwi amarillo y melocotón. Su textura es suave y ligera, permitiendo que cada capa de sabor se exprese con precisión.

items.title: Hario - V60 Ceramic White
items.desc: De diseño japonés, te permite aprovechar al máximo tu café de una manera simple y efectiva. Este método de filtrado es muy divertido y te permite experimentar con diferentes extracciones. La versión de cerámica es una de las mejores opciones. Su forma cónica y surcos especiales en el interior del gotero proporcionan un buen flujo del agua

items.title: Diego Mestas
items.desc: Dátiles, ciruela amarilla y níspero definen este café dulce y complejo de Cusco. Caramelo, almendras y chocolate con leche emergen en la taza, sostenidos por un cuerpo redondo y una acidez jugosa. Una experiencia de filtro refinada y equilibrada.

items.title: Camiseta "Roasted in Poblenou"
items.desc: Camiseta de 100 % algodón con diseño de Basora Studio. Roasted in Poblenou since 2011: un recordatorio de dónde venimos y hacia dónde vamos.

items.title: Descafeinado - Chambakú
items.desc: Más rico de lo que muchos piensan, este Chambakú Descafeinado presenta notas muy balanceadas y dulces de chocolate 80% y azúcar moscovado. Es un café con una acidez muy suave, un cuerpo muy redondo, y muy fácil de beber con leche, además de tener un ligero retrogusto a manzana golden que también hará las delicias de los cafeteros más exigentes.

items.title: Nomad atHome Specials
items.desc: Explora el lado más aventurero del café de especialidad con Specials , nuestra suscripción mensual a microlotes únicos, seleccionados por su perfil sensorial y origen excepcional. Cada mes, un café distinto para sorprender tu paladar.

items.title: Termo NOMAD
items.desc: Diseñado junto a Basora Studio, el Termo NOMAD combina forma y función en 0,5 L de capacidad. Mantiene el calor hasta 12 horas y el frío hasta 24. Compacto, ligero y fiel al café en cualquier momento.

items.title: LIBRO "ARXIU DE NOMAD COFFEE"
items.desc:
10 años hace de aquel carrito de café movido por Jordi Mestre entre mercados de Londres. 10 años en los que en Nomad Coffee han pasado muchas cosas que contar y de las que estamos muy orgullosos.
Es aquí, en este libro, en el que os contamos como ha sido para nosotros este recorrido y en como la familia ha ido creciendo a lo largo de éstos últimos años.

items.title: Cafetera La Marzocco Linea Mini
items.desc: Inspirada en la Linea Classic, la Linea Mini ofrece el rendimiento de una cafetera profesional en un formato compacto para el hogar. Con doble caldera, grupo saturado, control PID y ajuste de temperatura, garantiza una extracción precisa y consistente. Ahora con conectividad a la app La Marzocco Home para control remoto.

items.title: Producto exclusivo cafeterías
items.desc:
¿Quieres probar todos nuestros cafés en el mismo pack?
Hemos preparado una caja super especial con todos ellos. Es una caja con 50 gr de cada uno de los cafés que tenemos en este momento en nuestro menú. Recuerde que siempre es un menú rotativo, ya que en Nomad solo trabajamos con cafés de cosecha reciente.
¡Disfrútalos!

items.title: Fellow Stagg Filters
items.desc: Filtros de fondo plano diseñados específicamente para los Stagg Drippers. Pasaron por muchas iteraciones para traer este diseño. El papel es lo suficientemente pesado como para no arrugarse, probado para la taza más limpia y arrugado con la cantidad óptima de ondas para que no se peguen.

items.title: Bialetti - Cafetera Italiana Moka Express
items.desc: La Bialetti Moka Express es la cafetera italiana más icónica, diseñada para preparar un espresso aromático de manera sencilla en casa. Fabricada en aluminio, con un diseño octogonal atemporal, es ideal para quienes disfrutan del café clásico italiano.

items.title: Ecuador El Dorado Wush Wush
items.desc: El Dorado is a high-elevation farm in Loja, Ecuador, established in 2017 by the Elder family in partnership with Bernard Uhe, combining Colombian generational expertise with Ecuadorian terroir. Cultivating Geisha, Wush Wush, SL28, and Sidra, the farm has earned multiple Cup of Excellence and Golden Cup placements, reflecting its precision-driven approach to producing exceptional coffees.

items.title: Panama Hacienda Esmeralda Leon Gesha
items.desc: Few producers have shaped specialty coffee quite like Hacienda La Esmeralda. Since the Peterson family's groundbreaking discovery of Gesha's potential in 2004, their pursuit of quality has continued to redefine what's possible in coffee. We've worked directly with the family since 2019, building a relationship through annual selections, visits to their farms in Boquete, and a shared curiosity for exceptional coffee. Today, we're proud to continue representing their work, celebrating the innovation and dedication behind each new harvest.

items.title: Krampus
items.desc: As sounds of concern fill the air in our roastery each holiday season, we know Krampus has made his annual appearance. This year, he set his sights on a special Kenya Peaberry from Kamunyaka Washing Station, part of the Iria-Ini Farmers Cooperative Society. Built in collaboration with station management through careful peaberry separations throughout the harvest, this lot showcases the distinctive character of Kenyan coffee.

items.title: Framily
items.desc: We’re delighted to share the return of our annual Holiday Coffee, a joyful, crowd-pleasing release that captures the spirit of gathering. This year’s offering comes from Bensa, Ethiopia, sourced through our partners at Testi Coffee in the renowned Sidama region. Roasted to a deeply developed medium profile, this coffee offers a rich cocoa foundation layered with notes of spiced berry compote and a lingering sweetness.

items.title: IO-F-20
items.desc: Grown at 1,850 meters above sea level at Hacienda La Papaya in the Saraguro region of southern Ecuador, this lot comes from producer Juan Pena, a corner of the country building a quiet reputation for coffees with real character and clarity. The altitude and washed process work together to keep the cup clean and expressive, letting the natural qualities of the fruit come through without distraction.

items.title: Decaf Espresso - Colombia San Antonio
items.desc: Sourced in partnership with Pergamino Exporters, this decaf brings together carefully selected washed micro-lots from San Antonio, Inzá, a region of Colombia we've been buying coffee from for nearly a decade. Rather than purchasing an already-decaffeinated coffee, we build the lot specifically for sugarcane EA decaffeination, prioritizing sweetness, balance, and clarity. We roast this coffee a bit more developed to emphasize its sweetness and body, creating an approachable, versatile decaf that performs particularly well as espresso, both on its own and with milk.

items.title: Colombia Jhoan Vergara Gesha
items.desc: Grown at 1,750 meters above sea level at Las Flores in Huila, Colombia, this washed Gesha reflects Jhoan Vergara’s meticulous approach to coffee production. Combining generations of agricultural knowledge with a deep understanding of fermentation and sensory analysis, Jhoan has established Las Flores as a source of exceptional coffees featured on competition stages around the world. This Gesha highlights his commitment to precision, clarity, and varietal expression.

items.title: Guatemala Finca Libano Gesha
items.desc: Nestled in the volcanic slopes of Guatemala’s Acatenango region, El Libano has been cultivated by the Pérez family for over a century. Grown at 1,900 meters above sea level, this Gesha reflects generations of agricultural knowledge and a continued commitment to quality under Herbert Estuardo Pérez Liquidano. Through thoughtful cultivation and a dedication to improving each harvest, El Libano has earned a reputation for producing exceptional coffees.

items.title: Curio
items.desc: Jairo Arcila, a third-generation coffee grower from Quindío, Colombia, has built a legacy of excellence by blending tradition, innovation, and community impact. With the guidance of his sons, Jairo has embraced advanced processing techniques and cultivated exotic varieties like Pink Bourbon and Gesha across his six farms, creating coffees like this Pink Bourbon. With his collaborative approach, Jairo has excelled at creating coffees that simultaneously represent the tradition of coffee cultivation while also illuminating the path forward.

items.title: Panama Elida Gesha Mina Honey
items.desc: Elida Estate in Boquete, Panama has become synonymous with industry-leading quality when it comes to coffee. Winning the best of Panama and the choice of many world champions, their Gesha has literally changed the way coffee is now traded. Enjoy legendary work from true master farming, perfectly encapsulating what we expect from a washed Gesha grown in Panama.

items.title: Mexico Silvia Herrera Tupi
items.desc: In the highlands of Chiapas, Mexico, Silvia Carolina Herrera Hernandez has built a reputation for producing exceptional coffee. Her family's farm, located in Nuevo San Luis, Ocozocoautla de Espinosa, reflects a deep commitment to organic and sustainable practices, placing it at the forefront of Mexico’s growing specialty coffee movement.

items.title: Guatemala El Injerto Gesha
items.desc: Grown in the mineral-rich highlands of Huehuetenango, this washed Gesha reflects over a century of agricultural legacy at Finca El Injerto. First planted in 1900 and stewarded today by the third and fourth generations of the Aguirre family, El Injerto is a leader in sustainable, precision-driven coffee production.

items.title: Panama Kotowa Las Brujas Washed - Cafe Only
Mexico Finca Santa Cruz Gesha
items.desc: Located in the mountains of Chiapas, Mexico, Finca Santa Cruz is a family-operated farm led by José “Pepe” Argüello, a third-generation coffee producer with a remarkable commitment to quality. Situated near the biodiverse El Triunfo Biosphere Reserve, the farm has earned international recognition for its exceptional coffees, including multiple first-place finishes in Mexico's Cup of Excellence. Through careful cultivation, thoughtful processing, and a deep respect for the surrounding environment, Pepe and his family continue to produce some of Mexico's most celebrated coffees.

items.title: Colombia Altos de Quitumpamba
items.desc: From the high elevations of Nariño, this Pink Bourbon from Altos de Quitumpamba in Buesaco is grown at 2,200 meters, where altitude and volcanic soils drive intensity and clarity. Produced by Carolina Chalapud Daza and Guillermo Torres Daza, it’s a carefully washed coffee with monitored fermentation and slow raised-bed drying, resulting in a remarkably complex, high-elevation expression of Pink Bourbon.

items.title: Smiley Coffee Ludlow Blend - 10oz Case Pack
items.desc: Ludlow blend represents our most sophisticated roast, meticulously crafted to complement milk-based beverages effortlessly. It features a naturally sugar-rich coffee that harmonizes with fats, resulting in a plethora of intricate caramelized notes during the roasting journey. Expect hints of dark chocolate and robust, winey berry undertones in this versatile coffee blend, perfect for both drip and espresso preparations.

items.title: Smiley Coffee 1972 Blend - 10oz Case Pack
items.desc: Comprised of coffees from Ethiopia and Colombia, this blend is designed to work exceedingly well as a modern, floral espresso or as a balanced filter coffee. We roast this coffee to be light and expressive, while still maintaining the sweet cup profile of both its components. This blend will convert even the most skeptical to specialty.

items.title: Panama Esmeralda Lino Gesha Anaerobic
items.desc: The story of Hacienda La Esmeralda and the Gesha coffee variety is one of chance, dedication, and innovation. The Peterson family's discovery and cultivation of the Gesha variety on their Panamanian farm revolutionized the coffee industry, leading to the creation of some of the world's most esteemed and quality coffees, and setting new standards for quality and specialty coffee production. This is a product of the esteemed farm.

items.title: Colombia Aponte Village Honey
items.desc: A perennial standout from the Inga producers of Aponte, this community lot from Nariño captures the highland precision and structured sweetness that have made the village a fixture in our annual sourcing. The cup is richly sweet, with a vivid red fruit note that threads through caramelized sugars. Unconventionally processed as a red honey, the coffee undergoes partial drying prior to depulping, a technique that intensifies fruit esters and lends a plush tactile to the profile.

items.title: Colombia Finca Anaya Wush Wush
items.desc: Finca Anaya is a family-run farm in Acevedo, Huila, led by third-generation producer Sergio Darío Aranda Gómez. Drawing on more than fifteen years of experience in coffee, Sergio has developed a highly controlled approach to fermentation and processing, using precise time, temperature, and recirculated fermentation liquids to shape distinct sensory profiles. This washed Wush Wush reflects that approach with a bright, clean cup layered with tropical fruit, citrus, florals, and caramel sweetness.

items.title: Kenya Kamavindi Gesha
items.desc: Kamavindi Estate is a third-generation family farm in Embu County, situated at 1,680 meters on the southeastern slopes of Mount Kenya. This exceptionally rare Gesha microlot comes from a small planting on the estate and reflects both the variety’s delicate character and the clarity, structure, and vibrant acidity associated with high-elevation Kenyan coffee. Our relationship with Kamavindi began years ago through Peter Mbature, whose work has since helped deepen our access to distinctive coffees across Kenya.

items.title: Kenya Kagunyu AA
items.desc: Kagunyu is one of three washing stations operated by the Rumukia Farmers Cooperative Society in Nyeri, receiving coffee from roughly 600 smallholder producers farming the volcanic soils between Mt. Kenya and the Aberdare range. For this washed lot, ripe cherry is carefully sorted before depulping, fermentation, washing, and drying on raised beds, resulting in the bright acidity, clarity, and fruit character associated with coffees from this part of Kenya.

items.title: El Salvador Santa Rosa Honey
items.desc: Our relationship with Finca Santa Rosa spans more than a decade, with the last eight years shaped by an increasingly collaborative process of selection, feedback, and refinement. Raul’s precision in agronomy, processing, and lot separation allows us to cup and build our purchases from individual day lots, selecting only Pacamara coffees that meet an exceptionally high quality threshold.

items.title: 8oz GaeaStar Cups Case Pack
items.desc: Case Pack (45 cups per case)

items.title: Kenya Kamunyaka AA
items.desc: This AA seperation comes from Kamunyaka, a washing station within the Iria-Ini Farmers Cooperative Society in Kenya’s central highlands. Sitting around 1,700 meters above sea level and serving a community of smallholder producers, Kamunyaka is part of a broader effort within Iria-Ini to revitalize its stations through careful processing, experimentation, and a renewed focus on cup quality. This natural lot reflects that transformation and the station’s growing potential.

items.title: Panama Iris Estate Ascension Series Gesha
items.desc: This Echelon-exclusive Gesha from Savage Coffees represents the highest expression of Jamison Savage’s work in Panama, where extreme elevation, meticulous farming, and boundary-pushing processing come together. Drawn from a program responsible for some of the world’s most celebrated competition coffees, this lot offers a rare glimpse into the precision and innovation that define Savage Coffees at its peak.

items.title: Kenya Kiamwangi Natural
items.desc: This naturally processed coffee comes from the Iria-Ini Farmers Cooperative Society, a community of roughly 3,500 smallholder producers farming at high elevations in central Kenya. In recent years, the cooperative has invested heavily in quality, experimenting with natural processing and expanding its ability to evaluate coffees at origin. The result is a vivid expression of Iria-Ini’s renewed focus on careful processing, producer investment, and the long-term potential of the region.

items.title: Honduras Fredy Perez
items.desc: Fredy Perez is a longtime producer in San Andrés, Lempira, and one of the people who first helped us find our footing in this relatively young coffee-producing region. Since beginning our work here around 2021, Fredy has become both a trusted producer and an important local connection, helping introduce us to neighboring farmers while continuing to push the quality of his own coffees forward.

items.title: Ethiopia Mullugeta Muntasha Natural
items.desc: Mullugeta Muntasha’s journey from truck driver to esteemed coffee producer reflects his passion and dedication. Raised in Bursa, a region where coffee was once unknown, Mullugeta returned to his roots in 2021 to establish Dawencho, a drying station that soon earned accolades in the Cup of Excellence. By 2022, four of the top 10 winners were from his lots, including the top-ranking coffee from his brother-in-law. This natural lot reflects his hard work and dedication to elevating coffee production in his home region.

items.title: India Ratnagiri Thermal-Shock
items.desc: Located in the rolling hills of Chikmagalur, Ratnagiri Estate is one of the premiere coffee estates producing specialty coffee in India. Within the gates of Ratnagiri, Ashok Patre strives to develop processing methods that exceed the expectations of coffees from India. With determination, Ashok works alongside two microbiologists to track fermentation metrics, which have yielded coffees that are exceedingly balanced and clean, reflected in this inaugural offering from India.

items.title: El Salvador Santa Rosa
items.desc: This deeply sweet washed coffee from the Chalatenango Mountains comes from Finca Santa Rosa, owned and operated by our good friend Jorge Raul Rivera. Grape and rose lead the cup, opening into a layered and complex profile that has made Santa Rosa a standout in our coffee lineup.

items.title: Ecuador La Papaya Anaerobic
notes: With a complex finish of honey
items.desc: This anaerobic natural processed coffee from Juan Peña hits all the marks we love about limited-oxygen fermentation. Expect a winey and fruity cup reminiscent of cherry, with a complex finish of honey and stone fruit. La Papaya has become a shining example of agricultural innovation and this is one offering you don’t want to miss.

items.title: Panama Kotowa Las Brujas Gesha Natural - Cafe Only
Costa Rica Volcan Azul SL28 - Cafe Only
Ethiopia Shakiso Doyenne Natural - Cafe Only
Morning Mayhem
items.desc: Step into the ring, caffeine fiends! Magic & bird has tag teamed with Onyx Coffee Lab to slug your mouth with "Morning Mayhem"!! This coffee will suplex your sleepy taste buds and there's no tap-out. Your palate's about to get pile-driven into full-flavor submission. Brew at your own risk.

items.title: Costa Rica Las Lajas Natural
items.desc: This naturally processed coffee has become a staple in our Central American offerings and a reflection of our years working with Las Lajas. Today, they process this lot specifically for us, building a profile around the attributes we’ve come to love. Expect notes of pineapple and blueberry with a soft milk chocolate sweetness.

items.title: Mexico Oaxaca Yogondoy Gesha
items.desc: San Vicente Yogondoy Geisha is produced by six farmers in Oaxaca’s Sierra Sur, where coffee grows beneath native shade on forested slopes cooled by Pacific winds. Rooted in Zapotec traditions and communal practices like Tequio, the community has steadily improved both coffee quality and yields through years of investment in farm health and biodiversity.

items.title: Colombia Adrian Lasso Typica Mejorado
items.desc: Esteemed for its intricate and unparalleled flavor profile, Typica Mejorado delights with vibrant notes of tropical fruits, underscored by a bright, lively acidity. The Lasso family have taken their Mejorado variety and accentuated the fruited characteristics and the acidity through their thermal-shock processing. Expect pungent notes of tropical fruit throughout the drinking experience.

items.title: Panama Savage Coffees Gesha
items.desc: The Savage Coffee line is a collaboration of boutique coffee producers located in Boquete Valley and Volcan, Panama, working together to produce some of the finest coffees in the world, directly to your door. With expertise derived from generations of producers who maintain best practice techniques and a strict attention to detail from agronomy to processing. This washed Gesha variety highlights the hard work and collaborative spirit of the Savage line.

items.title: Panama Elida Gesha Falda Washed
items.desc: Elida Estate in Boquete, Panama has become synonymous with industry-leading quality when it comes to coffee. Most recently winning the best of Panama and the choice of many world champions, their Gesha has literally changed the way coffee is now traded. Enjoy legendary work from true master farming, perfectly encapsulating what we expect from a washed Gesha grown in Panama.

items.title: Pamana Elida Estate Falda Gesha
items.desc: Elida Estate in Boquete, Panama has become synonymous with industry-leading quality when it comes to coffee. Winning the best of Panama and the choice of many world champions, their Gesha has literally changed the way coffee is now traded. Enjoy legendary work from true master farming, perfectly encapsulating what we expect from a washed Gesha grown in Panama.

items.title: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe Gotiti G1
items.desc: Gotiti is produced by 868 smallholder farmers in Ethiopia’s Gedeb woreda, where coffee is grown beneath acacia and false banana trees in the cool, forested highlands of Yirgacheffe. Delivered by foot or mule to the local washing station, each lot is carefully separated, washed, fermented, and dried to preserve clarity and traceability.

items.title: Ethiopia Agaro Yukro G1
items.desc: Sourced through our long-standing relationship with Red Fox Coffee, Yukro is produced by smallholder farmers in Wanja Kersa, in Ethiopia’s western Agaro region. Agaro’s earlier harvest makes this one of the first fresh washed Ethiopian coffees to arrive each year, while meticulous processing at the Yukro washing station delivers a clean, sweet, and floral profile with remarkable longevity. Versatile enough for both single-origin service and blending, Yukro will be a cornerstone of our 2026 summer coffee program.

items.title: Kenya Gachatha AB
items.desc: The Gachatha washing cooperative in Kenya continues to be an invaluable partner, producing coffee that exemplifies the synergy between Nyeri's high-elevation terroir and the enduring expertise of the region’s farming community. This year’s offering is a vivid expression of their work- citric, layered, and exceptionally versatile.

items.title: Colombia Mártir Mujeres
items.desc: For our Doyenne program, we worked with Osito Coffee to build this lot from women producers within Mártir, a producer group in La Plata centered on quality, transparency, and shared progress. Their commitment to environmentally responsible farming makes this coffee a natural expression of Doyenne’s mission to support women producing exceptional coffee.

items.title: Colombia El Vergel Yirgacheffe Natural
items.desc: El Vergel’s Yirgacheffe selection brings Ethiopian coffee genetics into the distinct growing conditions of Tolima, Colombia. Rather than recreating an Ethiopian profile, this lot explores how those genetics express themselves through El Vergel’s altitude, volcanic soils, and meticulous farming.

items.title: Colombia El Vergel Java Natural
items.desc: This Java from El Vergel immediately stood out for its delicate florals and dynamic sweetness, qualities that often draw comparisons to Gesha. Harvested in the morning and processed through a carefully controlled 74-hour submerged carbonic maceration followed by slow drying, this micro-lot highlights the variety’s elegance, complexity, and exceptional high-elevation character.

items.title: Colombia Benjamin Tunubala Pink Bourbon
items.desc: Benjamin Tunubalá is a third-generation producer from Mesopotamia, Inzá, carrying forward a coffee-growing legacy begun by his grandfather, Pedro, one of the region’s early pioneers. This Pink Bourbon comes from La Aragona, Benjamin’s three-hectare varietal project at 1,850 meters, where volcanic soils and high elevation contribute to exceptional clarity and complexity.

items.title: Colombia Altos de Quitumpamba Chiroso
items.desc: Following our first offering from Altos de Quitumpamba, we're excited to share this second release from Carolina Chalapud Daza and Guillermo Torres Daza, this time showcasing the remarkable Chiroso variety. Grown at 2,200 meters in the volcanic soils of Buesaco, Nariño, and processed with a meticulous washed method featuring monitored fermentation and slow raised-bed drying, the result is a coffee that balances crystalline acidity, delicate florals, and a deeply expressive sweetness.

items.title: Ecuador Jose Jijon
items.desc: This is our second release of Fincas del Putushio, a new planting from Jose Jijon. Working together with his father Pepe, they used what they had learned developing Finca El Soledad and adapted it to a high-elevation farm in a different region. Through unique challenges and trials, the effort put forth yields a tremendously clean and elegant cup.

items.title: Colombia Agualinda Chiroso
items.desc: Sourced from our friends at Pergamino (now a decade-long relationship in Colombia), comes this remarkably bright and clean offering from Antioquia. Pergamino also operates one of the best micro mills for specialty coffee which holds major sway over quality and informs the final cup. We love chiroso for the bright acidity and structure throughout the cup.

items.title: Colombia El Paraiso Letty Gesha
items.desc: Diego Bermudez has become one of the most influential producers in specialty coffee, with his innovative fermentation techniques shaping competition coffees served on stages around the world. This Gesha showcases his signature thermal shock process, where carefully controlled multi-stage fermentations and rapid temperature changes amplify the variety's floral, citrus-driven character into vibrant notes of ripe peach, mango, and tropical fruit.

items.title: Tanzania Iloma Station
items.desc: Located in Tanzania's southern highlands, Iloma AMCOS unites producers from the neighboring villages of Mufaumbo and Illomba. Since its founding in 2011, the cooperative has expanded from producing traditional washed coffees to carefully crafted natural lots, while continuing to invest in processing infrastructure, community development, and agricultural education. The result is coffees that express the vibrant character of southern Tanzania.

items.title: Panama Chevas Coffee Estate Gesha
items.desc: We met José Luis through a chance encounter—not once, but twice. After he stopped by our café with a handful of samples, we unexpectedly crossed paths again just a week later while driving through Panama. Since that first tasting, José has relentlessly refined his work at Chevas Coffee Estates. In only a few years, the farm has emerged as one of Panama's most promising producers.

items.title: Ecuador El Dorado Gesha
items.desc: El Dorado is a high-elevation farm in Loja, Ecuador, established in 2017 by the Elder family in partnership with Bernard Uhe, combining Colombian generational expertise with Ecuadorian terroir. Cultivating Geisha, Wush Wush, SL28, and Sidra, the farm has earned multiple Cup of Excellence and Golden Cup placements, reflecting its precision-driven approach to producing exceptional coffees.

items.title: Decaf Ethiopia Suke Quto
items.desc: Born into coffee cultivation but trained in environmental conservation, Tesfaye Bekele returned to his native Guji to lead reforestation efforts after devastating wildfire, ultimately founding Suke Quto Farm and its renowned washing station. Defined by its silky tactile feel, this Swiss Water–processed decaf Ethiopia is refined and sweet throughout, a testament to Suke Quto’s standing as one of the premier sources of exceptional coffee in the country.

items.title: Nepal Sindhupalchowk Paachpokhari Co-Ferment
items.desc: This mixed fruit co-ferment lot comes from Paachpokhari in Nepal’s Sindhupalchowk region, where smallholder farmers cultivate coffee on steep terraced hillsides. As a young and emerging coffee origin, Nepal produces only small volumes, making experimental lots like this one a rare expression of the country’s developing specialty coffee scene.

items.title: Peru Andres Torre Ore
items.desc: Andres Torre Ore grows coffee at Finca Muruhuay, where the Andes meet the Amazon. Through thoughtful farm management and years of experience, Andres produces coffees that showcase the unique character and potential of this remarkable growing region. We love this coffee primarily has a balanced, very drinkable filter coffee.

items.title: Colombia Juan Jimenez Gesha
items.desc: Juan is a second-generation farmer who has been cultivating coffee for over 40 years on his 16-hectare farm, El Porvenir, in Palestina, Huila. His expertise and early investment in the Pink Bourbon cultivar have earned him recognition and awards within the specialty coffee community, so we are excited to continue working alongside Juan to roast this small batch of his Gesha variety.

items.title: Colombia Las Moras
items.desc:
Circadian is a fully tailored coffee experience designed to optimize your caffeine intake without sacrificing sleep.
Select the perfect amount of caffeine in each cup with our caffeine calculator, or buy the box set to try them all.

items.title: Colombia La Riviera Sudan Rume
items.desc: La Riviera's coffees, cultivated at 1,750 meters in Santa Rosa de Cabal, Risaralda, reflect a deep commitment to ecological farming and innovative processing. Producers Julio Madrid and Julio Quiceno, who have been refining their craft since 2013, employ cutting-edge fermentation techniques to elevate the coffee's complexity and balance.

items.title: Colombia Doña Martha Gesha
items.desc: El Diviso has become one of the defining names in modern Colombian specialty coffee, known for pushing processing innovation while maintaining clarity and balance in the cup. This washed Gesha immediately stood out to us on the cupping table for its remarkable florals and refined structure, offering a more elegant and articulate expression of the Lasso brothers’ work while still carrying the complexity and vibrancy they are known for.

items.title: Colombia El Jardin Gesha
items.desc: This washed lot comes from Leonardo Henao, a dedicated coffee producer from Santa Bárbara, Antioquia, whose lifelong passion for coffee has driven him to refine his craft and pursue excellence, earning him the title of Champion of the Cup of Excellence in 2020. After selling his farm in 2022, he returned to coffee production in 2024 with the acquisition of Finca El Jardín, where he continues to apply his expertise while sharing his knowledge with fellow producers, fostering a thriving and diverse coffee culture in Colombia.

items.title: Decaf Espresso - Peru Norandino
items.desc: Sourced from the highlands of Cajamarca in northern Peru, this decaf espresso highlights the region’s long tradition of smallholder coffee production and careful washed processing. Expect a balanced cup with notes of chocolate, citrus, and soft stone fruit sweetness, offering clarity and structure without sacrificing approachability. A dependable and expressive profile, shaped by generations of producer knowledge and Andean terroir.

items.title: Panama Iris Estate Gesha
items.desc: This is an offering from our friend Jameson Savage from the esteemed Iris Estate. While we have passively worked together on a few projects over the last season, we have solidified our partnership at the outset of the harvest with an offering from each one of his farms. This Iris Estate Gesha is a washed expression of the variety, ushering forward a clean and floral cup, reminiscent of jasmine and lime.

items.title: Panama Finca Deborah Gesha Washed
items.desc: Jamison Savage is a renowned figure in the hyper-specialty coffee world, with multiple champions using his coffees. His work is highly regarded, both within the Savage coffee line and his producing farms. During a visit to Panama, we met Jamison and toured Finca Deborah, witnessing his deep knowledge and passion for coffee. This passion is evident in the quality of his coffee, like with this washed Gesha.

items.title: Panama Finca Deborah Gesha Anaerobic
items.desc: Jamison Savage is a name that has loomed large within the competition world for years. We have long been fans of his work both within the Savage coffee line, as well as his own producing farms. During our time in Panama for a harvest visit, we made the picturesque drive from Boquete to Volcan, Panama. We met Jamison in Volcan, hopped into his 4x4 truck, and made the steep climb up to Finca Deborah. Spending an afternoon with Jamison was illuminating, showing the depth of both knowledge and passion that he has for coffee, people, and the land.

items.title: Colombia Juan Jimenez Pink Bourbon
items.desc: Juan is a second-generation farmer who has been cultivating coffee for over 40 years on his 16-hectare farm, El Porvenir, in Palestina, Huila. His expertise and early investment in the Pink Bourbon cultivar have earned him recognition and awards within the specialty coffee community. We have been purchasing his coffee for years, which will come at no surprise after tasting this microlot with its structured acidities and pungent notes of sweet lemon and grapefruit.

items.title: Decaf Colombia Sebastian Ramirez Red Fruits
items.desc: This is a unique fruit-infused decaffeinated micro-lot from our friend Sebastian Ramirez. Sebas often experiments at El Placer with the addition of fruit within the fermentation process, and this particular coffee has been co-fermented with red fruits, imparting a strong flavor of fruit throughout the drinking experience.

items.title: Colombia Edward Sandoval Chiroso
items.desc: This is another washed micro-lot from our friends at Pergamino coffee. Edward Sandoval produces coffee in Ibague, Tolima, which yields an altogether unique cup profile. Highlighting the unique terroir of Tolima, expect delicate melon and a tea-like tactile in this versatile coffee. We enjoy this coffee thoroughly as a filter offering.

items.title: Colombia Juan Jimenez Pink Bourbon - Cafe Only
items.desc: Juan is a second-generation farmer who has been cultivating coffee for over 40 years on his 16-hectare farm, El Porvenir, in Palestina, Huila. His expertise and early investment in the Pink Bourbon cultivar have earned him recognition and awards within the specialty coffee community. We have been purchasing his coffee for years, which will come at no surprise after tasting this microlot with its structured acidities and pungent notes of sweet lemon and grapefruit.

items.title: Ecuador La Papaya Oak Barrel Anaerobic - Cafes Only
items.desc: This Typica variety from Juan Peña undergoes a distinctive limited-oxygen fermentation process in Ecuadorian rum barrels. The outcome is a coffee rich in natural sugars and fruit esters derived from the long fermentation of coffee cherries. In the cup, these characteristics manifest as raw wine and ripe berries, making this offering particularly appealing to lovers of fruit-forward coffees.

items.title: Colombia Nestor Lasso Ombligon - Cafes Only
items.desc: This natural processed, thermal shock Ombligon is one of the most intense coffees we have ever roasted. With layered, high sweetness, this micro-lot propelled itself to the number one spot at the WBC in 2022, and has since garnered many more accolades. We have partnered with Lohas in Colombia to bring this specially processed Ombligon, which has wowed Baristas and Consumers alike.

items.title: Decaf Colombia Inzá San Antonio - Cafes Only
items.desc: Rest easy with this washed decaffeinated coffee from Cauca, Inzá. We’ve intentionally sourced this coffee for the purpose of decaffeination, selecting this regional lot from San Antonio for it’s structured sweetness of red apple and raw sugar, with a balanced acidity reminiscent of pear.

items.title: Southern Weather - Cafes Only
items.desc: Southern Weather embodies everything we love about specialty coffee and has evolved into a foundational blend. We brew this in our own cafes as a “House” filter option and love how it balances the relationship between modern citric acidity flavors with full bodied chocolates. This comfortable, yet surprisingly complex and sophisticated coffee is approachable to all. It performs well on its own for the purist or with fats such as dairy or plant based beverages, making it a true answer for all coffee needs.

items.title: Geometry - Cafes Only
items.desc: Geometry has been defined as "describing spaces that lie beyond the normal range of human experience." Soon it will also be defined as "that coffee from Onyx that I am in love with and completely redefined my relationship with coffee." It's our answer for everything and has two of our favorite coffees—a washed processed Ethiopian & Colombian. This blend has become one of our favorite coffees. We love it as a filter coffee, and we love it as espresso. And not only does is it taste great as either but it's easy to dial in as espresso or filter.

items.title: Monarch - Cafes Only
items.desc: Monarch is our most developed roast that conveys a flavor profile that we intentionally designed to work well with milk. Cream and plant based beverages mix with ease, creating a rich, decadent flavor. It involves a natural, sugar-dense coffee that binds to the fats and creates multiple complex caramelized notes during the roasting process. Look for dark chocolate and undertones of thick winey berries. Enjoy as drip or espresso.

items.title: Kaliluni AA, Kenya, Washed
items.desc: Fully washed and raised-bed dried, this mixed SL lot from Kaliluni opens with notes of red currant and bright pomegranate, with a sweet undertone of brown sugar throughout each sip.

items.title: Los Arcos, Guatemala, Washed
items.desc: A crisp, comforting Washed coffee from the eastern highlands of Jalapa. Bright red apple leads into the dark, jammy sweetness of raisin, carried by a structured black tea body and a clean, lingering finish.

items.title: El Árbol, Nicaragua, CM Natural Jasper
items.desc: Pineapple, orange and chocolate

items.title: Trifle
items.desc: Vanilla custard, brandy (0% alcohol) and baked stonefruit

items.title: Kiambu Regional PB, Kenya, Washed
items.desc: A Peaberry selection from Kiambu's Washed regional lots, where the coffee delivers a concentrated, juicy cup of fresh plum and raisin over a sweet toffee finish.

items.title: Thageini Lot 2226, Kenya, CM Washed Indigo
items.desc:
Mandarin, caramel and lavender
200g

items.title: Guji Mudole, Ethiopia, Supernatural
items.desc:
Tropical, red berries and concord grape
200g

items.title: La Huerta, Honduras, Washed
items.desc: A bright, floral Washed Catimor from the slopes of Santa Barbara Mountain. Soft botanical notes give way to red apple, rounding out with a gentle walnut finish.

items.title: Yirgacheffe Gelcha Kindu Lot 1426, Ethiopia, CM Natural Indigo
items.desc: Malt, blueberry and raisin

items.title: Kuriru AB, Kenya, Washed
items.desc: Currant, grapefruit and green tea

items.title: La Merced, Guatemala, Natural
items.desc: A juicy, balanced natural Bourbon from one of Guatemala's most storied family farms. Ripe yellow plum and sweet cherry open into bright strawberry jam, settling into a rich dark chocolate finish that keeps every sip round and generous.

items.title: Yirgacheffe Amederaro Lot 1626, Ethiopia, Nitrogen Natural Jasper
items.desc: A vivid and complex cup of orange soda lifted by tropical fruits, with a cacao sweetness building as it cools.

items.title: Los Pirineos Lot 07, El Salvador, Natural
items.desc: A classic high-grown Bourbon given a slow, careful natural dry, Lot 07 opens with ripe apricot over a sweet botanical base, settling into a chamomile finish.

items.title: Bridazul Lot 1, Nicaragua, Supernatural
items.desc: A vivid, fruit-driven Supernatural from the hills of Nueva Segovia. Ripe plum leads into a bright raisin lift, rounded out by a gentle chocolate sweetness.

items.title: Bloom Filter Distributor
items.desc:
Bloom is a next-generation brew bed preparation tool designed to give you more control before the first pour.
Using a dual needle system, Bloom breaks up clumps, releases hidden air pockets, reduces static and helps lift chaff from the coffee bed. The result is faster saturation, smoother flow and a more consistent extraction from brew to brew.
Compact, customisable and built for daily use, Bloom is made for brewers who want more clarity, control and repeatability in the cup, whether at home, in a café or on the competition stage.

items.title: Special Order - Link Roaster
items.desc:
The Nucleus Link Roaster is a portable sample roaster designed for small-batch roasting with precision, consistency and control.
With a 50–100g batch capacity, Link allows you to roast and assess coffee wherever you are, whether you are profiling new samples, preparing for cupping, or exploring a coffee’s potential in more detail. Through the Link App and LINK Studio software, you can choose from a wide range of profiles, monitor your roast in real time, and customise your approach based on variety, process and density.
Compact, portable and built for professional use, Link is made for roaster

items.title: Raspberry Candy Filter
items.desc: Inspired by the coffee used by ONA Coffee founder, Saša Śestić in his winning routine at the 2015 World Barista Championship, Raspberry Candy has become a favourite in the coffee industry for its playful fruit notes and indulgent sweetness. This long-awaited filter release of Raspberry Candy captures those same fruit-forward flavours in a black coffee experience. With layers of Ethiopian coffees and a delicate roast profile, it highlights the unmistakable raspberry candy character alongside a deep, rich chocolate and a floral, hibiscus-like finish.

items.title: NCD Pulse
items.desc: The NCD Pulse is equipped with four uniquely styled blades with anti-static coating, which disperse coffee for an even extraction while preventing the retention of coffee grinds. Using Pulse Vibration technology, the NCD Pulse allows for multiple vibration settings during grind distribution.

items.title: Chilling Rock Pack Espresso
items.desc:
Specifically designed to optimise taste and workflow for Extract-Chilling Espresso Beverages.
Pack of 6 Extract Chilling Rocks.
*Espresso Paragon mount not included

items.title: Paragon Espresso
items.desc:
Specifically designed to optimise taste and workflow for Extract-Chilling Espresso Beverages, the Nucleus Coffee Tools Paragon Espresso system helps baristas extract espresso that captures the most aromatic and flavourful compounds from every shot.
Full set: includes 4 Chilling Rocks and 2 Paragon Espresso mounts.
Optimise your brewing and taste the difference of true extract-chilling innovation. Shop the Chilling Rock Pack for extra cooling capacity, or pair the Paragon espresso tools with your favourite ONA espresso coffee .

items.title: Artisan Barista Jugs
items.desc: A staple at any espresso bar, these milk jugs by Artisan Barista are crafted with a balanced handle and a curved body to give you fantastic flow control in every pour. Their medium sharp spout with a downward tip offers versatile applications and lets you be creative with your latte art.

Whether you're a professional barista or a home coffee enthusiast, the Nucleus Coffee Tools Pack of Extract Chilling Rocks will make your coffee-making experience effortless and enjoyable.
Pack of 5 or 25 Chilling Rocks.
*Filter Paragon mount not included

Same technology and precision as the current Nucleus Coffee Distribution tool, scientifically tested at the Switzerland University of Applied Technologies, only now pretty in pink 🌸

Free shipping.

The Nucleus Coffee Tools Coffee Distributor (NCD) is a revolutionary coffee distribution tool designed by former World Barista Champion Sasa Sestic.
